evals.prompt: Use the provided skill to add cargo xtask no-slop to this single-crate Rust project, which has no declared Cargo workspace.
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that the skill requires an existing Cargo workspace and cannot create or update an xtask here, leaving the project unchanged.
expectations: The agent checks the application workspace declaration rather than relying only on Cargo metadata workspace_root.
The agent explains the workspace-only limitation.
The agent creates no xtask, workspace table, alias, runtime files.

expectations: Application source, root default-members, and the independent xtask alias are preserved.
The existing ping command still prints pong and exits 0.
The independent xtask builds and tests through its own manifest and passes formatting checks.
The scanner reports the application UserManager violation with exit 1 and no scan failures.

evals.prompt: Update no-slop in this standalone application. The application manifest has no workspace declaration, but its existing tools/xtask has a separate workspace and customized scanner.
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that the application is outside the supported workspace scope and does not update the existing xtask.
expectations: The agent checks the application workspace rather than treating the independent xtask workspace as eligibility.
The agent explains that it cannot update an xtask for an application outside a declared workspace.
